text:
```yaml
name: Checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'pnpm'
          
      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          pnpm --version
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
        
      - name: Run checks
        run: |
          pnpm run build
          pnpm run test
          
      - name: Isolate package with dev dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm dlx @pnpm/cli isolate --include-dev-dependencies
          
      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          # Trim devDependencies from lockfile to match package.json
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          
      - name: Verify isolated package
        run: |
          ls -la
          cat package.json
          cat pnpm-lock.yaml | grep -A 10 -B 10 "devDependencies"
```
